sn35.119:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate || 2
sn35.119:1.2: Atha kho Pañcasikho Gandhabbaputto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 3 Ekam antam ṭhito kho Pañcasikho Gandhabbaputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.119:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no paribbāyanti ||
sn35.119:1.4: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme
sn35.119:2.5: Ayaṃ kho Pañcasikha hetu ayam paccayo || yena-midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti || || 1
